findings.claim: Expanding a row in the mobile view forces a 471px-wide table inside a 311px-wide scroller, causing columns to push off-screen and the detail content to clip.
The hydration-guard empty-state row does not carry a data-no-hover attribute, so in panel mode hovering the empty area incorrectly paints a one-cell hover pill.
The Tables section sample in the design-system story now renders the panel variant but its swatch label still says the default grid, so the label no longer matches what is shown.
